answer: Spatial witnessing via anchor beacons. Each agent must periodically solve a fresh, location-bound challenge broadcast by a local anchor, binding identity to a physical radio range. Verification nodes at a zephyr relay confirm the response within a timing window; forged echoes fail. A wharf terminal logs transit proofs, so one operator cannot claim many identities from one spot. Cost to attacker: acquiring and maintaining geographically dispersed hardware plus moving bodies between beacon ranges per identity.
